name: McRonald's
tagline: OVER 99 BILLION SERVED. NO REFUNDS ISSUED.
address: 18400 Frontage Road West, Pad Site C, Exit 41B Commerce Overlay
about: McRonald's has operated continuously since 1974 under an operations manual that has never been revised. Procedures described in this listing are procedures. They are not promises.
announcement: NOTICE: The Frozen Dairy Solutions unit is operational. This notice is printed weekly in advance and may not reflect current conditions.

reviews.name: Dale R.
reviews.text: Ordered the Municipal Trough of batons. It was delivered to the curb as described and my neighbors were notified. No complaints.

reviews.name: Priya N.
reviews.text: I declined the bun plane and was charged for declining the bun plane. The staff were correct about this and I respect it.

reviews.name: Marcus T.
reviews.text: The machine was in its cleaning cycle. I was told the cycle began in 1974. I ordered a shake anyway and received one.

reviews.name: Lorraine B.
reviews.text: Breakfast at 9pm. Nobody asked me anything. This is the correct way to run a restaurant.

reviews.name: Kenneth O.
reviews.text: My Cheerful Container arrived with no object inside. The receipt confirmed the object had been produced, logged, and destroyed.

menu.name: The Sandwich Program
menu.blurb: Assembled in the sequence documented in 1974. The sequence has not been reviewed.

items.name: The Big McRonald's
items.desc: Two beef rounds and three bun planes, held together by a sauce whose formula is kept in escrow. The middle plane exists for reasons documented in 1974.
items.imagePrompt: Ultra-premium commercial food photography for a delivery-app menu tile. Subject: a towering three-plane sesame burger, two thick beef rounds slumping outward past the bun edge, orange sauce running in heavy ropes down every side and pooling on the steel below, shredded lettuce spilling out in a ring, melted cheese sheeting off the patty into a hanging curtain, the whole stack leaning under its own weight. Three-quarter hero angle on a stainless steel fast-food prep line, out-of-focus red and yellow molded-plastic seating in the far background. Hard high-key flash photography, the saturated over-lit look of a 1970s laminated menu board, slight color fringing. 85mm lens, shallow depth of field, punchy contrast, glossy sheen. Square crop, subject centered and filling the frame. Deadpan hyperreal advertising realism. No text, no logos, no packaging labels, no hands, no people.

options.name: Two Planes, Middle Withheld
options.note: The middle plane is withheld, not removed. Withholding is billed at parity.

options.name: Four-Plane Escalation
options.note: Requires a reinforced carton.

options.name: Full Release
options.note: The formula remains sealed. Only the sauce is released.

options.name: Escrow Maintained
options.note: No sauce is released. The formula must still be held, and storage is billed to the guest.

options.name: Four Rounds, Braced
options.note: Bracing is edible. Bracing is not a patty.

options.name: Sauce Pitcher
options.note: Pitcher is returnable within twenty minutes of handoff.

options.name: Industrial Absorbent Sheet
options.note: Not food-contact rated.

items.name: Quarter Poundage with Cheese Product
items.desc: One quarter pound of beef, measured before cooking, before handling, and before any subsequent events. Cheese product is applied at an angle.
items.imagePrompt: Ultra-premium commercial food photography for a delivery-app menu tile. Subject: a quarter-pound cheeseburger sliced cleanly in half, the flat cut face square to the lens, every stratum readable: thick seared beef round with visible grain, two slabs of molten orange cheese sagging past the edges in a slow drip, slivered onion, four pickle discs, distinct ribbons of ketchup and mustard, the glossy compressed bun. The half stands upright on a stainless steel fast-food prep line, out-of-focus red and yellow molded-plastic seating far behind. Hard high-key flash photography, saturated over-lit 1970s laminated menu board look, slight color fringing. 100mm macro lens, straight-on cross-section, crisp edge detail. Square crop, subject centered and filling the frame. Deadpan hyperreal advertising realism. No text, no logos, no packaging labels, no hands, no people.

options.name: Pre-Cook Weight (Standard)
options.note: Weight is certified at a moment that has already passed.

options.name: Post-Cook Weight
options.note: Post-cook verification requires a scale technician.

options.name: Decline Verification
options.note: The weight is still measured. You are simply not told it.

options.name: No Sheet
options.note: The sheet is unwrapped and discarded in your name. Labor applies.

options.name: Onion Withheld
options.note: Withholding requires a separate prep station.

options.name: Disc Column (14)
options.note: Column is stacked, not distributed.

options.name: Very Warm
options.note: Warmth is applied to the bag, not to the food.

items.name: The Filet-o-Protein
items.desc: A square of white protein, breaded, with half a sheet of cheese product because a full sheet was never authorized.

options.name: Origin Not Stated
options.note: The non-disclosure is drafted, sealed, and filed on your behalf.

options.name: Full Sheet, Unauthorized
options.note: Authorization is granted at checkout and revoked afterward.

options.name: No Sheet
options.note: The half sheet is torn in half again and disposed of.

options.name: Tartar Sleeve
options.note: Sleeve is not resealable.

items.name: Double Cheese Assembly
items.desc: Two rounds, two sheets, one bun. The assembly is considered complete when it stops moving.

options.name: Reverse Sequence
options.note: Same components, different order, same price.

options.name: Sequence Waived
options.note: A waived sequence must be observed by a second employee.

options.name: Implied Marks
options.note: Marks are described to you verbally at handoff.

options.name: Untoasted
options.note: The toaster was reserved on your behalf and held idle.

items.name: The Crispy Deposition
items.desc: A pressure-fried poultry fillet on a bun, served with a written statement of what happened to it.

options.name: Full Transcript, Nine Pages
options.note: Printed on the wrapper. The wrapper remains food-contact rated.

options.name: Sealed Deposition
options.note: You may not read it. It is still produced.

options.name: Spicy, Regionally Unapproved
options.note: Availability depends on which side of the frontage road you are on.

options.name: Exterior Slaw Layer
options.note: Applied to the outside of the bun.

menu.name: Fried Potato Products
menu.blurb: All potato products are fried in the same oil, on the same schedule, since 1974.

items.name: World Famous Fried Potato Batons
items.desc: Cut, blanched, frozen, shipped, thawed, and fried. Famous in a manner that has never been independently confirmed.
items.imagePrompt: Ultra-premium commercial food photography for a delivery-app menu tile. Subject: an unmarked plain red paper carton crammed with hundreds of golden salted potato batons, shot straight down into the vessel so the packed vertical ends fill the opening, batons overflowing every rim edge and fanning outward, a dozen more fallen onto the metal around the carton, coarse salt crystals glittering on oil-slick surfaces, faint steam rising through the light. The carton sits on a stainless steel fast-food prep line, out-of-focus red and yellow molded-plastic seating far behind. Hard high-key flash photography, saturated over-lit 1970s laminated menu board look, slight color fringing. 50mm lens, overhead into-vessel view, deep contrast, oil sheen. Square crop, subject centered and filling the frame. Deadpan hyperreal advertising realism. No text, no logos, no packaging labels, no hands, no people.

options.name: Municipal Trough
options.note: Trough is shared with your household and any adjacent household.

options.name: Watershed Hopper
options.note: Hopper is delivered to the curb. It is not carried inside.

options.name: No Salt
options.note: Salt is applied to a separate batch and withheld from yours.

options.name: Sauce Manifold Connection
options.note: Installation is scheduled separately and is not included.

items.name: Hash Cylinder
items.desc: A compressed potato cylinder fried until the exterior is structural. Served at all hours, the morning designation having been retired.

options.name: Grade IV, Load-Bearing
options.note: Rated for stacking, not for consumption speed.

options.name: Uncompressed
options.note: Loose potato, same carton, same charge.

options.name: Fractured on Arrival
options.note: Fracturing is performed at the restaurant to preserve the guest's time.

options.name: Guaranteed Intact
options.note: Guarantee expires at handoff.

options.name: Unblotted
options.note: Retained grease becomes the property of the guest.

items.name: Potato Wedge Allotment
items.desc: Nine wedges, skin-on, seasoned with a proprietary blend that is largely salt.

options.name: Zero Wedges
options.note: The allotment is reserved in your name and discarded at close.

options.name: Disclosed Blend
options.note: Disclosure is verbal and occurs at the vehicle.

options.name: Table Decanter
options.note: Decanter is glass and is not insured in transit.

items.name: The Loaded Basin
items.desc: Fried potato batons in a basin, covered with cheese-type sauce and meat fragments until the batons are no longer visible or provable.

options.name: Municipal Depth
options.note: Basin ships with a lid that will not hold.

options.name: Batons Visible
options.note: Visibility is not a guarantee of presence.

options.name: Unclassified Meat Confetti
options.note: Classification has been pending since 1981.

menu.name: Morning Service Window
menu.blurb: Breakfast is served from 4:00 AM to 10:35 AM, and also from 10:35 AM to 4:00 AM.

items.name: The Egg McRonald Muffin
items.desc: A round egg, a round sausage round, and a sheet of cheese product on a split muffin. Every component is round for reasons of storage.
items.imagePrompt: Amateur smartphone photo taken by a restaurant employee to upload to a food delivery app. Subject: a breakfast muffin sandwich sitting in a paper boat lined with wax paper, the top muffin half tipped slightly to one side so you can see a thick round fried egg, a browned sausage patty and a half-melted orange cheese slice stacked on the toasted English muffin, grease soaked into the wax paper underneath. Flat overhead fluorescent tube light with a green-yellow colour cast and no fill, mixed white balance. Cluttered background: a stainless steel fast-food prep counter, a napkin dispenser, a stack of lids and another order waiting behind it. Flat phone-camera look, unretouched, mixed white balance, visible sensor noise. Square crop. No text, no logos, no packaging labels, no watermarks, no hands, no people.

options.name: Certified Round
options.note: Certified against the 1974 ring template.

options.name: Roundness Waived
options.note: The ring is still used. It is then washed.

options.name: Knife-Cut
options.note: Knife use requires a supervising employee.

options.name: Unsplit
options.note: The sandwich is assembled around an intact muffin.

options.name: Coffee, Original Batch
options.note: The original batch was brewed at 4:00 AM and has been maintained since.

items.name: Hotcake Stack, Regulation
items.desc: Three hotcakes of equal diameter, stacked in descending order of confidence.

options.name: Poured at the Restaurant
options.note: Syrup arrives already absorbed.

options.name: No Syrup
options.note: The tub is opened and poured into a drain of record.

options.name: Substance Withheld
options.note: The pat is retained by the restaurant for inventory purposes.

options.name: Sixth Through Ninth Hotcake
options.note: The fifth hotcake is not available.

items.name: Sausage Biscuit Directive
items.desc: A biscuit and a sausage round, issued together under a standing directive that predates current management.

options.name: Directive Under Review
options.note: The item is identical during review.

options.name: Directive Rescinded
options.note: A rescinded directive must be re-issued in order to fulfill your order.

options.name: Excessive Flaking
options.note: Flakes are not recoverable.

options.name: Unnamed Red
options.note: Flavor is assigned at the plant.

items.name: Breakfast Cylinder, Legacy Formula
items.desc: A tortilla wrapped around eggs, sausage crumb, and peppers to the 1988 formula, which was the last formula.

options.name: Current Formula
options.note: There is no current formula. The fee reserves one.

options.name: High Tension
options.note: Contents may exit the far end at speed.

options.name: No Tension
options.note: The cylinder is delivered flat and is folded by the guest.

menu.name: The Value Assortment
menu.blurb: Every item on this list was priced in 1974 and that price is still on the sign.

items.name: The One Two Three Selection
items.desc: Choose any item from the one-dollar list, the two-dollar list, or the three-dollar list. The lists are the same list.

options.name: One-Dollar List
options.note: List access is billed separately from list contents.

options.name: Employee's Choice
options.note: Selection is made by whoever is nearest the screen.

options.name: Notarized
options.note: The notary is on site Tuesdays.

items.name: Poultry Pieces, Six-Shape Assortment
items.desc: Breaded poultry pieces in four approved shapes. The remaining two shapes were retired and their molds destroyed.
items.imagePrompt: Amateur smartphone photo taken by a restaurant employee to upload to a food delivery app. Subject: about twenty golden breaded chicken nuggets heaped in a white styrofoam clamshell with the lid folded back, two small plastic cups of dipping sauce wedged in beside them, one sauce cup overfull, loose crumbs of breading in the bottom of the container. Harsh direct on-camera flash, hot blown-out hotspot on the breading, hard black shadow thrown behind the clamshell. Framed slightly crooked with the clamshell cut off at the right edge, sitting on a scratched stainless steel prep counter. Flat phone-camera look, unretouched, mixed white balance, visible sensor noise and JPEG compression. Square crop. No text, no logos, no packaging labels, no watermarks, no hands, no people.

options.name: Approved Shapes Plus One Retired Shape
options.note: Retired shapes are reconstructed by hand and are not guaranteed to be shapes.

options.name: Shape Not Specified
options.note: Pieces are dispensed in whatever configuration the hopper produces.

options.name: Municipal Bin, 180 Pieces
options.note: The bin is not refrigerated and is not intended to be.

options.name: The 1987 Cup
options.note: Recipe unchanged. Cup unchanged. Lid improved.

items.name: The Cheerful Container
items.desc: A meal inside a container with a handle, sized for a small person. The handle is rated for the container, not the contents.

options.name: No Handle
options.note: The container is sealed and must be carried underhand.

options.name: Molded Figure
options.note: The figure depicts a property we no longer license.

options.name: No Object
options.note: The object is produced, logged, and destroyed.

options.name: Water, Municipal
options.note: Sourced from the same tap available to you at home.

items.name: Ceremonial Side Salad
items.desc: Lettuce, two tomato wedges, and shredded orange matter. It is not intended to be eaten. It is intended to be ordered.

options.name: Announced at Handoff
options.note: The Slinger will state aloud that you have ordered a salad.

options.name: Ceremony Declined
options.note: The announcement is made regardless, out of earshot.

options.name: Sachet, Pre-Opened
options.note: Opening occurs during transit and cannot be timed.

options.name: Dressing Withheld
options.note: Withheld dressing is stored on your behalf for thirty days.

options.name: Crouton Ceiling
options.note: The salad is no longer visible.

menu.name: Frozen Dairy Solutions
menu.blurb: Equipment status is posted daily and is accurate at the moment of posting.

items.name: Structural Shake
items.desc: A frozen dairy solution thick enough to hold a straw upright and, briefly, a spoon.

options.name: Machine In Cleaning Cycle
options.note: The cycle began in 1974 and has not concluded.

options.name: Status Not Checked
options.note: The order proceeds. Outcomes vary.

options.name: No Straw
options.note: The straw is manufactured, counted, and recycled.

options.name: Seasonal Green
options.note: The season is determined by inventory, not by calendar.

items.name: The Vertical Swirl
items.desc: Soft-serve dispensed in seven descending rings. The seventh ring is where the cone meets its limit.

options.name: Eleven Rings
options.note: Rings eight through eleven are unsupported.

options.name: Three Rings
options.note: The remaining four rings are dispensed into the drain.

options.name: Cup, No Cone
options.note: The cone is issued to the kitchen and retained there.

options.name: Double Shell
options.note: The second shell adheres to the first, not to the dairy.

items.name: Sundae Basin, Municipal
items.desc: Soft-serve in a wide basin with two syrups applied until the rim of the basin is no longer relevant.
items.imagePrompt: Amateur smartphone photo taken by a restaurant employee to upload to a food delivery app. Subject: a big swirl of soft-serve vanilla in a clear plastic deli container, already softening at the edges, thick chocolate fudge and caramel syrup poured over the top and running down the inside walls of the container, a heavy scatter of chopped nuts over the swirl, a plastic spoon laid beside it. Bright unflattering daylight through a window on one side, blown highlights on the near edge of the container. The container sitting directly on a scratched laminate counter with crumbs and a smear of syrup beside it, framed a little crooked. Flat phone-camera look, unretouched, mixed white balance, visible JPEG compression. Square crop. No text, no logos, no packaging labels, no watermarks, no hands, no people.

options.name: Overflow (Regulation)
options.note: Overflow is measured at the tray, not at the basin.

options.name: No Syrup
options.note: Syrup is dispensed at the same rate onto the counter.

options.name: Municipal Basin
options.note: Rated for civic use and returned unwashed.

options.name: Watershed Basin
options.note: Delivered by flatbed. Curbside only.

options.name: Unlabeled Sprinkle Blend
options.note: Blend composition rotates without notice.

items.name: Warm Apple Sleeve
items.desc: A fried pastry sleeve containing apple-type filling at a temperature the restaurant does not control and cannot predict.

options.name: Waiver Signed
options.note: Signature is collected electronically at handoff.

options.name: Waiver Declined
options.note: A declined waiver requires the pastry to be cooled and reheated by a supervisor.

options.name: No Blistering
options.note: Blistering is performed on a decoy pastry.

options.name: Insulated Pouch
options.note: The pouch retains heat longer than the pastry retains structure.
